status: strict expanding-window shadow validation; no production score changes

method.features: Raw Directional Edge components observed at completed close T.
method.trainingRule: For each T, only earlier observations whose T+5 outcome had fully matured before T are eligible.
method.mapping: Each component is split into five equal-count training bins; historical mean 5D returns are converted to within-training percentile quality and linearly interpolated. No v1.1 hand-tuned U-curve is used.
method.weights: 45% absolute momentum, 35% relative momentum, 20% breadth persistence.
